references.text: Earlier mention of Sisera's nine hundred iron chariots and his military force
Deborah's song describes the battle at the Kishon River where Sisera and his army were defeated
The Lord's promise to bring Sisera with his chariots and army to the Kishon River
The psalm mentions Sisera and the events at the Kishon River as an example of God's victory over enemies
Iron chariots are mentioned as a military threat against Israel
Pharaoh's chariots and army gathered against Israel, similar military mobilization
Description of God's intervention in the area where Sisera gathered his forces
